THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: Mawa/Prale/3/6/2.Ministry of Land Reference No.: 4-3/7/2016/HW/39.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the LandAcquisition Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends toacquire the following land/ servitude* which is required for a publicpurpose:
